messages.content: "請問你能幫我找到藝術家文森·梵谷在蘇富比拍賣平台上作品名為「星夜」的價格，然後再去查詢愛德華·孟克在佳士得拍賣平台上作品名為「吶喊」的價格嗎？之後，我想在紐約公共圖書館搜尋哈波·李的作品名為「梅岡城故事」的書籍，然後在大英圖書館尋找喬治·奧威爾的作品名為「1984」的書籍。"

message.reasoning:
The user wants to find prices for two artworks on auction platforms, then search for books in libraries. We have two functions: library_search_book and art_auction_fetch_artwork_price. We need to call them twice for the artworks, then twice for the books.

We need to output the results. The user asked in Chinese. We should respond in Chinese. We need to call the functions. We'll do two calls to art_auction_fetch_artwork_price: first for "星夜" by Vincent van Gogh on Sotheby's (蘇富比). Then for "吶喊" by Edvard Munch on Christie's (佳士得). Then two calls to library_search_book: first for "梅岡城故事" by 哈波·李 at New York Public Library (紐約公共圖書館). Then "1984" by George Orwell at British Library (大英圖書館).

We need to use the function calls. The function signature: art_auction_fetch_artwork_price takes artwork_name, artist, platform optional. For the first: artwork_name="星夜", artist="文森·梵谷", platform="蘇富比". For second: artwork_name="吶喊", artist="愛德華·孟克", platform="佳士得".

For library_search_book: title, author, platform optional. For first: title="梅岡城故事", author="哈波·李", platform="紐約公共圖書館". Second: title="1984", author="喬治·奧威爾", platform="大英圖書館".

We need to call functions sequentially. We'll produce function calls.
